Date: 2026-03-10T16:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff: FinBanc evaluation & timeline

Leah —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan and a short evaluation plan to help make the pilot run smoothly. The goal is to validate quality vs. your existing reranker and measure end-to-end latency under your typical traffic profile.

High-level proposed MAP (attached: FinBanc_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Week 0: Stakeholder alignment, data access checklist, sign-off on success metrics
- Weeks 1–2: Ingestion + baseline runs (sample sets from trading alerts)
- Weeks 3–4: Closed-loop comparison + SLO load test (p95 latency)
- Week 5: Stakeholder review + decision meeting

Immediate asks for your side:
1) Confirm internal champion(s) and approver(s) for data access and procurement.
2) Share sample dataset access (S3 prefix or secure upload) and a point of contact for engineering.
3) Agree on success metrics (we suggested precision@k / latency at p95).

Next steps: If we get a quick thumbs up on the champion and data owner, we can kick off the ingestion window next week. Priya and Rafael are on the thread to cover onboarding and evaluation harness setup.

Attachments: FinBanc_MAP_v1.xlsx, evaluation_plan_v1.md

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tom / Leah —

Following up now that Leah looped Tom in as the new project owner — welcome Tom, great to meet you. Brief note to relaunch the MAP and propose a condensed 6-week evaluation plan that fits your Q3 priorities. I’ve attached an updated MAP (FinBanc_MAP_v2.xlsx) that tightens the milestones and clarifies deliverables from both sides.

Why a 6-week window? We aim to keep the POC focused on business outcomes while delivering measurable signals for a production decision:
- Weeks 1–2: Secure access & baseline runs (Redwood engineers handle ingestion, FinBanc provides sample set)
- Week 3: Model comparison + quality review (metric: precision@10, false positive rate)
- Week 4: Load & p95 latency verification under 2x expected load
- Week 5: Executive summary & ROI estimate (cost per 1M tokens at your configured batch settings)
- Week 6: Decision meeting + optional contract/commit discussion

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Tom: Confirm the primary technical contact (engineering + data access owner) and procurement lead (Sandra is fine if procurement is involved).
2) FinBanc: Provide S3 access or secure upload by May 25.
3) Redwood: We’ll provision a sandbox model endpoint and a test harness; Rafael will share the runbook.
4) Meeting: 30-min kickoff next Tue May 25 at 10am ET — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Related links: HubSpot pipeline record (https://hubspot.company/contacts/FB-2026-023) and DocuSign link for the PII DPA we sent previously (https://app.docusign.com/doc/ABC123-finbanc-map).

Attachments: FinBanc_MAP_v2.xlsx

If that timeline is too aggressive, we can stretch to 8 weeks, but we find the tighter window gives clearer momentum for procurement and exec reviews. Priya and Rafael are on hand to support technical onboarding and the evaluation harness. Evelyn (cc) will be our internal escalation if any SLA or capacity exceptions are required.

Thanks and excited to get started —
Alex Martinez
